notes.title: New function "Connect" Major update　[07/19~07/31]
notes.notes:
In this update, I will announce a new function "Connect", and a new design.

[h1]Connect[/h1]

[h3]You can play stages made by other players, and upload your original stage.[/h3]

Here's what it looks like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061100/8bc076ceee49a6e33be173a31d6c43adb6382a63.png[/img]
You can create, upload, and download stages here.

[h3]Steps to create stage↓[/h3]
1. Click the "Create" button with "edit mode"
2. Place the goal and exit stage with the stage cleared
3. Check if you passed the requirements, and click the "Upload (Replace)" button to submit

[h3]One stage per person. Create a stage with your best efforts.[/h3]

You can choose stages from the bottom right of the "Connect" top screen.

There is also a trophy element implemented to count the stages you cleared.

[b]Please note that the stage upload function is only available by 07/31/2024 JST.[/b]


[h2]New design[/h2]

To add more depth to the game screen, I've added new animation and adjusted some designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061100/cdb03fe6f5e7bf90596046d8d4ac8df2279792c8.png[/img]

+Several bug fix

If you encounter any trouble, please inform me.
Thank you.
